direction: An impact edge points from a changed dependency to a consumer that may be affected.

nodes.title: Automator application
nodes.summary: The desktop automation application: Electron shell, React surfaces, compiled .NET modules, and host services.

nodes.title: Electron desktop shell
nodes.summary: Owns windows, preload bridge, IPC handlers, backend process lifecycle, and desktop adapters.

nodes.title: React renderer
nodes.summary: Composes the launcher/workspace UI, shared surfaces, and registered tab views.

nodes.title: Renderer action facade
nodes.summary: Creates typed, module-scoped action clients used by compiled module views.

nodes.title: Backend capability context
nodes.summary: Wraps host-granted services with module identity, capabilities, and cancellation lifetime.

nodes.title: Global Action Search
nodes.summary: Routes registered commands and website aliases from the launcher search surface.

nodes.title: Options and Variables
nodes.summary: Shared UI for application preferences and global variables.

nodes.title: Run Activity and Notifications
nodes.summary: Displays run history, notifications, and the latest module result.

nodes.title: Tab and view registries
nodes.summary: Maps registered tab metadata and view kinds to the renderer's compiled views.

nodes.title: Launcher
nodes.summary: Searches and activates applications, commands, aliases, and launcher actions.

nodes.title: Script Runner
nodes.summary: Runs saved scripts and trusted templates through the host-granted process service.

nodes.title: API
nodes.summary: Runs saved HTTP profiles through shared network policy and secret resolution.

nodes.title: Browser Automation
nodes.summary: Discovers and runs Playwright tests and browser profiles from the Browser Automation view.

nodes.title: Workflows
nodes.summary: Composes saved Script, API, and Browser profiles into workflow runs.

nodes.title: Scheduler
nodes.summary: Persists schedules and starts saved scripts or workflows when due.

nodes.title: Work Time
nodes.summary: Records work sessions and exposes summaries and CSV export.

nodes.title: Website Launcher
nodes.summary: Manages website aliases and launches their configured destinations.

nodes.title: Automation module registry
nodes.summary: Validates module/action versions and capabilities before dispatching actions to compiled modules.

nodes.title: Workflow engine
nodes.summary: Resolves workflow steps and runs saved profiles through scoped services.

nodes.title: Scheduler coordinator
nodes.summary: Owns schedule state and due-run coordination.

nodes.title: Work Time coordinator
nodes.summary: Owns work-time session state and persisted summaries.

nodes.title: JSON-RPC backend
nodes.summary: Reads JSON-RPC requests, validates and dispatches them, writes results, and publishes notifications.

nodes.title: Automation library store
nodes.summary: Persists profiles, variables, activity records, schedules, tags, and work-time data in SQLite.

nodes.title: HTTP service and network policy
nodes.summary: Sends profile requests while enforcing the configured network policy.

nodes.title: Local process service
nodes.summary: Runs explicitly configured executables and bounds captured stdout/stderr.

nodes.title: Playwright browser services
nodes.summary: Provides Playwright runtime discovery, browser execution, and test-runner integration.

nodes.title: Secret manager
nodes.summary: Resolves named secrets from Windows Credential Manager or the isolated test implementation.

nodes.title: Windows platform adapters
nodes.summary: Provides application discovery, activation, keyboard hooks, foreground tracking, settings, and website launch.

nodes.title: Renderer, IPC, and RPC contracts
nodes.summary: Shared request/response shapes, tab view kinds, RPC methods, and validated IPC payloads.

nodes.title: Settings store
nodes.summary: Stores preferences and versioned module settings separately from the automation library.

nodes.title: ScriptRunnerView
nodes.summary: Renderer view that consumes Script Runner actions and presents run results.

nodes.title: ApiView
nodes.summary: Renderer view that consumes API profile actions and presents request results.

nodes.title: WorkflowsView
nodes.summary: Renderer view that consumes workflow actions and run results.

nodes.title: SchedulerView
nodes.summary: Renderer view that consumes schedule actions and snapshots.

nodes.title: FocusSessionsView (Work Time)
nodes.summary: Renderer view for Work Time sessions, summaries, and CSV export.

nodes.title: WebsiteLauncherView
nodes.summary: Renderer view that consumes website alias actions and launch results.

nodes.title: BrowserAutomationView.run
nodes.summary: Renderer entry point for a test run; dispatches runTests and consumes the returned result.

nodes.title: AutomationServices.modules.dispatch
nodes.summary: Validates the module action request, assigns a request ID, and calls the preload bridge.

nodes.title: preload api.dispatchModuleAction
nodes.summary: Validates the renderer request and invokes the module-action IPC channel.

nodes.title: Electron module-action IPC handler
nodes.summary: Checks the calling frame and forwards the module action to the backend client.

nodes.title: BackendProcess.request
nodes.summary: Writes a JSON-RPC request to child stdin and returns the matching pending response.

nodes.title: BackendProcess.consumeStdout
nodes.summary: Parses backend stdout lines and resolves the matching response promise.

nodes.title: BackendServer.RunAsync
nodes.summary: Reads request lines from stdin and hands each line to request handling.

nodes.title: BackendServer.HandleLineAsync
nodes.summary: Queues a request line or dispatches service requests outside the command queue.

nodes.title: BackendServer.HandleLineCoreAsync
nodes.summary: Parses and validates a request, dispatches it, then writes a result or error.

nodes.title: BackendServer.DispatchAsync
nodes.summary: Routes the moduleAction protocol method to module action execution.

nodes.title: BackendServer.ExecuteModuleActionAsync
nodes.summary: Creates or requires a scoped module context and invokes the request executor callback.

nodes.title: AutomationRequestExecutor.ExecuteAsync
nodes.summary: Tracks request lifetime/cancellation and invokes the supplied module action callback.

nodes.title: AutomationModuleRegistry.DispatchAsync
nodes.summary: Checks registration, action version, active module, and capabilities before module dispatch.

nodes.title: BrowserAutomationModule.ExecuteAsync
nodes.summary: Selects the Browser Automation action and delegates runTests to the explorer.

nodes.title: BrowserAutomationModule.CreateExplorer
nodes.summary: Builds the explorer from the scoped library and process services.

nodes.title: PlaywrightTestExplorer.RunAsync
nodes.summary: Discovers the selected tests, executes the Playwright runner, and interprets the report.

nodes.title: PlaywrightTestExplorer.DiscoverTestsAsync
nodes.summary: Runs Playwright test --list and parses discovered test identities.

nodes.title: AutomationServicesContext.ContextProcessService.ExecuteAsync
nodes.summary: Applies the module lifetime/cancellation grant before delegating process execution.

nodes.title: LocalProcessExecutionService.ExecuteAsync
nodes.summary: Starts the configured executable and captures bounded stdout/stderr.

nodes.title: LocalProcessExecutionService.ReadBoundedAsync
nodes.summary: Reads process output while limiting retained text.

nodes.title: BackendServer.WriteProtocolAsync
nodes.summary: Serializes a JSON-RPC result or notification and writes it to stdout.

nodes.title: User
nodes.summary: The person using Automator surfaces.

nodes.title: SQLite database
nodes.summary: Local SQLite persistence used by the automation library store.
